The open-source core ships 37 features. **33 are proved end to end** by the feature proof: the four `hello-cairn` pipelines run on real servers across SQLite and Postgres storage, the in-process and DBOS runtimes, and the in-process and Postgres buses (`tests/e2e/hello`, run 2026-10-16 10:52 UTC).

## [Pipelines](/features/pipelines/)

| Feature | Proof | Shown in |
|---|---|---|
| Data pipelines | ✅ proved — 8 of 8 cells | `profile-and-publish` |
| Agentic pipelines (markdown templates) | ✅ proved — 8 of 8 cells | `ask-the-docs` |
| ML pipelines | ✅ proved — 8 of 8 cells | `tiny-finetune` |
| Flow pipelines | ✅ proved — 8 of 8 cells | `nightly-ops` |
